admission.justification: An exact host uv pin rejects newer self-updating installations and invites orchestration-only workarounds; numeric floor selection must stay distinct from the certified container pin.

applicability: Host task-worktree environment bootstrap using the canonical runtime contract and uv found on PATH.
conditions: Both versions are dotted nonnegative decimal parts; omitted trailing parts compare as zero.
AR_UV_VERSION remains the sole version assignment.
exclusions: The certified container installs exactly the contract version.
This policy does not relax the exact Python runtime checks or guarantee every future uv can successfully sync.

evidence: test_version_comparison_is_numeric (10 cases incl. 0.12.21/0.9.30/1.0.0); test_gate_uses_a_newer_uv_as_it_is; test_gate_uses_the_contract_version_itself; real builds evidence3/build1-0.12.21.log and build2-0.12.6.log

statement: AR_UV_VERSION names the lowest uv the environment script builds with; that version or any newer one on the PATH is used as it is, compared numerically part by part.
